title:
A "tab set" contains one or more "tabs", plus has a list of the individual tab names. This makes it easier for rendering HTML (or other output) because the bounds of each tab can be easily identified. The block children will all be {@link DocumentationTab}s. The tabs are defined by headings using the `=` leaders (instead of `#`): ```md == Stuff Some stuff == Nonsense Even more nonsense. == == ``` == Stuff Some stuff == Nonsense Even more nonsense. == == This produces HTML that contains the structure, but not the specific appearance or behavior to make the tabs work: ```html
  • Stuff
  • Nonsense

Stuff

Some stuff

...
...
``` @see DocumentationTab
name: DocumentationTabSet
